title: Body Diagram 11 Points
description: 2 captured saves. Source only; format, dependencies, or incomplete code prevent stock BASIC loading.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Body/joint data and graphics, 11 points
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines; consistent pointer base 22204; exact full length and end marker; byte-identical left/right recovery
versions.unavailableReason: The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player.
versions.startupSource:
10 CLS
20 BP=11
30 DIM B$(BP),A(BP),X(BP+3),Y(BP+3),C(BP)
50 FOR X=1TO BP:READ B$(X):NEXT X:FORZ=1TO4:READZ(Z):NEXTZ
60 DATARIGHT TOE,RIGHT ANKLE,RIGHT KNEE,RIGHT HIP,LEFT HIP,LEFT KNEE,LEFT ANKLE,LEFT SHOULDER,LEFT ELBOW,LEFT HAND,RIGHT SHOULDER,RIGHT ELBOW,RIGHT HAND,CHEST,NECK,RIGHT EAR,LEFT EAR
100 A$=INKEY$:IFA$=""THEN120ELSEIFA$="Q"THEN P=11ELSEIFA$="W"THENP=12ELSEIFA$="0"THENP=10ELSEIFVAL(A$)<>0THENP=VAL(A$)
120 PRINT@960,B$(P);"             ";
130 IF A$=" "THEN Z=Z+1:IFZ>4THENZ=1
140 IF A$=" "THEN C(P)=Z(Z)
150 A(P)=A(P)+C(P)
160 PRINT@P*3+384,A(P);
200 X=64:Y=44
